messages:
Priya: Heads-up 1: planning an APAC+EMEA-friendly webinar on Apr 30. Need owners for: multilingual reg page, timezone reminder schedule, captioning+translation workflow, and post-event localized clips + HubSpot segmentation. Whos in?

Ben: I can own reg page + reminder timing. Proposal: 3 reg page language options (EN/FR/DE) using URL param `?lang=` so we can A/B copy per locale. Reminder cadence: email 48h/2h + local-time SMS 1h for the registrant's TZ.

Olga: I'll run caption/translation vendor coordination. We can do auto English captions in Zoom, then human translate FR/DE. Vendor needs SRT + raw mp4 within 30m of end. Who will trigger the upload?

Tom: Ops can trigger uploads. Plan: Zoom cloud -> lambda -> s3://redwood-webinars/intl/2475001111/{raw, srt}. Then notify localization queue. Need an API key for vendor webhook.

webcast-bot: Scheduled: webinar_id=2475001111, start=2026-04-30T15:00:00Z. Cloud recording enabled. Auto-transcript=on.

Priya: Important: legal requires retention log for transcripts and opt-in copy in FR/DE. Also need a short consent checkbox on reg form for transcript reuse. Can we add that to the template?

Ben: Yep. Form fields: email, company, role (optional), phone (opt-in for SMS), preferred language (EN/FR/DE), consent checkbox (text variations in locale). Hidden params: utm_source + partner_ref.

Olga: Translation flow detail: 1) Zoom SRT -> pass to vendor (turnaround 24h for FR/DE) 2) vendor returns SRT + translated VTT 3) ops ingests -> marketing gets localized clips. We should also generate bilingual subtitles (EN+target language) for 1-2 highlight clips.

Tom: Implementation note: lambda will POST manifest to /localization/ingest with fields: mp4, en_srt, event_id, preferred_locales. Will also create task in Asana: "Loc: 2475001111". Who owns the clip list?

Priya: I'll curate highlight timestamps during the event (greenroom cues). Assign clip editor: Ben for EN, Olga for FR/DE supervision. Need 3 clips: 60s product hook, 90s demo, 45s CTA.

Ben: For HubSpot segmentation: create static list name `webinar_intl_0426_LANG` and contact property `webinar_pref_locale`. Workflow: if phone+opt-in -> add to SMS workflow; if 'request demo' checked -> route to #sales-intl. SLA: 2 hours during business hrs.

Olga: QA plan for captions: quick check 1) automated transcript cleanup (punctuation) 2) vendor spot-check 3) final QA on VTT timing. I'll draft a 5-min checklist.

Tom: Security note: vendor webhook keys stored in Secrets Manager. Lambda will use role `webcast-uploader` with least privilege. Will share IAM policy in the doc.

Priya: Small creative ask: can we have a localized registration thank-you page that shows regional follow-up webinar times and a calendar invite that respects TZ? Ben?

Ben: Yes, will create dynamic thank-you landing: shows two nearest regional replay slots and a button `Add to calendar (local time)`. Using `tzdetect.js` + ICS generator.

webcast-bot: Reminder: post-event assets available -> s3://redwood-webinars/intl/2475001111/ after processing. Expected within ~45m after end (auto + vendor latency).

Priya: Great. Next steps: Ben to push reg page with consent & lang params by Tue EOD, Tom to wire uploads + secrets, Olga to confirm vendor SLA and pricing, I will share greenroom cue sheet. Ping if any blockers.

Ben: Will do. Posting reg page draft shortly.

Olga: I'll confirm vendor tonight and post contact + turnaround in this thread.

Tom: I'll add lambda + webhook tests to the runbook and run one dry example.

Priya: Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll lock production settings 24h before.
